Three small sprites with backpacks run from different directions to meet, stopping under soft evening light to see each other. The camera slowly lowers and pushes forward along the path, establishing a cheerful atmosphere of reunion.
shot2: Warm light filters through tree gaps. Its smile lifts at the end of the sentence, while the others show expressions of thoughtfulness and disagreement. Leaves rustle beneath their feet. The camera slightly pushes in to emphasize the moment the suggestion is made.

The split paths form a distinct V-shape in the composition—one leading down to the visible coastline, the other ascending higher. Warm twilight hues deepen. Wind grows slightly louder. Backpack straps continue swinging due to momentum. The left points toward the seaside path, the right toward the high path, the middle stands in the center, looking both ways. The camera slowly lowers from above, clearly marking the decision point.

The central character squints into the wind, their ears and backpack straps fluttering gently, then quickly turns their head to ask, 'Should we look at the sea first or the clouds?
